yt_description:
Prepare to witness the epitome of terrible coding! 🤪 We're diving into Bogo Sort, also known as 'stupid sort' or 'permutation sort'. This algorithm is SO bad, it's actually hilarious.  Watch as we try to sort an array by randomly shuffling it until it's in order.  Spoiler alert: it takes FOREVER.  Is this the most useless algorithm in existence? Let us know your thoughts! 👇
